221170.Description:
Both sets contain 10 new cards all in foil version (5 types x 2 cards each) that will power up cards from UW1 & UW2!
Contents:
• 3 packs
•10 new foil cards
•1 official DBSCG die

227388.Description:
[Permanent] This card can't attack.
[+1] [Activate:Main] Draw 1 card, choose 1 card in your hand and place it at the bottom of your deck, then choose up to 1 red "Earthling"-only Battle Card with an energy cost of 2 in your hand and play it.
[-3] [Activate:Main] RRR, if your Leader Card is a red "Earthling"-only card and all of your energy is mono-red : Choose up to 1 red Unison Card with a specified cost of 4 in your hand and play it with 2 markers on it.

227389.Description:
[Blocker]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is a blue "Trunks : Future" card : When this card is played, you may choose 2 blue Battle Cards in your hand and place them in your life face up. If you do, add 2 cards from your life to your hand.

227390.Description:
[Permanent] This card gains , , , and in all areas.
[Auto] [Once per turn] If your Leader Card is a green "Ginyu Force" card and you have 2 or more energy : When this card's attack deals damage to an opponent or removes a marker from an opponent's Unison Card, play up to 1 green "Ginyu Force" card with an energy cost of 2 from your deck other than copies of this card, then shuffle your deck.

227391.Description: [Auto] If your Leader Card is a yellow "Gotenks : Adolescence" card : When this card is discarded by a [Union-Fusion] skill, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards, ignoring [Barrier], and switch it to Rest Mode. You can't activate the [Auto] skill on copies of this card for the turn.

227392.Description:
[Auto] When this card is played, add up to 1 "Dark Dragon Ball" card from your deck or Drop Area to your hand, then shuffle your deck if you looked through it.
[Activate Main] [Once per turn] 2, if your Leader Card is black, you have 3 or more energy, and you choose 1 non-black "Dark Dragon Ball" card in your hand and place it in your Drop Area : Play up to 1 'Dark Broly' card or non-black Battle Card with 'Xeno' in its character name and an energy cost of 4 or less from your deck or hand, then shuffle your deck if you looked through it.
